name: The Beacon

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.desc:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Chambered Compensator
perks.desc:
Stable barrel attachment.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.desc:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.desc:
Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Accelerated Coils
perks.desc:
Speeds up charge.
  •  Faster charge time
  •  Decreases impact damage

perks.name: Enhanced Battery
perks.desc:
Strong battery life.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Ionized Battery
perks.desc:
Large heavy battery.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed

perks.name: Liquid Coils
perks.desc:
Slower-building charge for higher damage.
  •  Increases impact damage
  •  Slower charge time

perks.name: Particle Repeater
perks.desc:
Improves stability. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Projection Fuse
perks.desc:
Distance optimizations.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.desc: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Collective Pugilism
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.desc: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Controlled Burst
perks.desc: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.desc: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: Classy Contender
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant class ability energy.

notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-SustainedDamage PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): Backup PvE roll for sustained DPS against a single yellow-bar target in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. The Beacon is a rapid-fire fusion rifle, which are rated F-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being a "strict downgrade from high-impact and precision frames for boss damage". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the battery is empty as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are good by comparison with its peers - you can see them at https://destiny.report/w/76739872/the-beacon and hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/76739872 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. With 9 bolts to control, look for a barrel perk that helps with recoil control together with any other stat that you want to bump. Accelerated Coils improves charge time by 40ms at the cost of ×0.98 base damage or Enhanced Battery in the battery perk slot gets you to the maximum of 8 shots. While losing out to precision and high-impact frames for total boss damage, if you wanted one for ease of use, in the first trait perk slot, Envious Arsenal refills the battery from reserves on dealing damage with both of your other weapons, Overflow refills the battery and boosts its capacity to ×2 of base (×2.2 when enhanced), rounded up, on picking up an ammo brick, Rewind Rounds refills 60% of hits landed (70% enhanced) from reserves when the battery empties or Demolitionist provides an instant battery refill on grenade use and generates chunk grenade ability energy on kills. In the second column, for damage, Bait and Switch boosts damage by ×1.3 for 10s (11s enhanced) for doing damage with your other two weapons as part of a weapon damage rotation, or Controlled Burst reduces charge time to ×0.9 and boosts damage by ×1.2 for 2s (2.5s enhanced) after a kill or landing all the bolts in a burst. The origin trait is particularly useful for a boss roll - Classy Contender provides 5% (6% enhanced) Class ability energy on kills. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a Charge Time mod or your preferred choice to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

Adamsdown_Boy written as at v9.5.6 (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-SustainedDamage PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for sustained boss DPS in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. The Beacon is a rapid-fire fusion rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being still the best overall "easy fusion" with a QoL charge time. The frame intrinsic fires 9 bolts and offers a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the battery's empty as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. It's difficult to make direct comparisons with the D2Foundary website down but hopefully when it's back https://d2foundry.gg/w/2161618499 will show how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. You'll probably need help with recoil control from the barrel perk or, if you're on M+KB and able to do so then look for some extra Handling. For the battery perk, you'll want to improve the battery's capacity, or maybe reduce the charge time. For sustained boss DPS there's the trusted weapon rotation trait perk pairing, which both proc on the same condition of dealing damage with both of your other weapons, of Envious Arsenal in the first column, to refill the battery from reserves and Bait and Switch boosts damage by ×1.3 for 10s (11s when enhanced). The Classy Contender origin trait provides 5% (6% enhanced) Class ability energy on kills, which is useful if not game-changing. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with an enhanced Charge Time mod or your preferred choice to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
